verses.1: Therefore, holy brothers, who are members of the heavenly congregation, you understood the apostle and high priest of our confession, Jesus.
verses.2: Believing that he was doing this in the same way as Moses did in his house.
verses.3: For this man deserves greater fame among Moses, in proportion to the greater honor that his builder possesses for having built him.
verses.4: For every house is built by someone, but God alone truly builds everything.
verses.5: And Moses was a faithful man throughout his entire life, serving as a healer for those who were sick.
verses.6: Christ, as a son, enters his house. We, on the other hand, are like his “homes”; we enjoy the comfort and joy that comes with hope.
verses.7: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says: “Today, if you hear His voice.”
verses.8: Do not harden your hearts, as in that day of trial in the wilderness.
verses.9: And your fathers tried them in the testing period, and they saw my works.
verses.10: Forty years… So I presented myself to them in that form. I said, “They wander in their hearts.” But they did not understand the paths I was following.
verses.11: As I am in my anger; may they be sent away from my presence.
verses.12: See, brothers, perhaps there may be in some of you a wicked distrust in the fact that you are to be separated from God.
verses.13: But please ask yourselves every day, until today comes, so that none of you may be hardened in their sin.
verses.14: For the members of Christ’s body have become strong, if we truly endure from the beginning until the end.
verses.15: In what he said: “Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts, as in times of crisis.”
verses.16: Why did they listen and then act accordingly? But not all those who left Egypt did so because of Moses.
verses.17: How long did he stand there for forty years? Not for those who sinned, for whom the animals fell into the wilderness.
verses.18: But why should they not be allowed to enter the place of punishment if they have been warned?
verses.19: And let us see that they were unable to enter due to distrust.
